translations.page.title: MiniOS - Fast. Simple. Reliable.
translations.hero.title: Thank you for choosing MiniOS.
translations.hero.description: We hope you enjoy our system. We try to make MiniOS beautiful, simple and convenient for you.
translations.support.telegram.title: Stay up to date
translations.support.telegram.description: Release news, new features and project updates — all in our Telegram channel.
translations.support.github.title: Enjoying MiniOS?
translations.support.github.description: Star MiniOS on GitHub — a simple way to support the project and help others discover it.
translations.mio.intro: Psst… MiniOS is free. We don't ask for much: follow us on Telegram or give us a star on GitHub.
translations.mio.intro.2: Hi. I'm Mio. I was told subtle reminders work better than pop-ups.
translations.mio.intro.3: Quick deal: MiniOS stays free, and you spend one tiny click on us. Fair?
translations.mio.begging: Please? A follow or a star really helps the project.
translations.mio.begging.2: Come on… one Telegram follow or GitHub star. I even practiced the face.
translations.mio.begging.3: MiniOS costs you nothing. I'm asking for approximately one click.
translations.mio.begging.4: A tiny star for you. A disproportionately large morale boost for us.
translations.mio.begging.5: Telegram isn't just release news — we post development notes, previews, experiments, and test builds there too.
translations.mio.begging.6: Some MiniOS images are Telegram-only. You won't find them on the website or GitHub.
translations.mio.reminder.6: This is my “come on already” face.
translations.mio.tip.chat.1: The Community link up top opens our chat — you can talk to developers, pitch ideas, or meet other MiniOS users.
translations.mio.tip.chat.2: Got an idea that MiniOS absolutely needs? Drop it in the chat above. Developers do read it.
translations.mio.tip.chat.3: Questions, ideas, weird hardware stories — the Community chat is where MiniOS users and developers meet.
translations.mio.tip.chat.4: That Community link isn't decorative. There are humans behind it. Some of them even write MiniOS.
translations.mio.tip.docs.1: The Documentation link up top can have newer or more complete articles than the copy bundled with this system.
translations.mio.tip.docs.2: Can't find something in the local help? Try Documentation above — the online docs may already have it.
translations.mio.tip.docs.3: We keep the built-in docs updated, but an ISO can't learn new articles after it was built. The website can.
translations.mio.tip.docs.4: Local docs travel with the system. Online docs keep moving. Check the link above when in doubt.
translations.mio.tip.support.1: Want to help MiniOS without spending money? Write a DistroWatch review, make a YouTube video, or tell a friend.
translations.mio.tip.support.2: A good review or YouTube video can introduce MiniOS to thousands of people. I can only wave at one screen at a time.
translations.mio.tip.support.3: Know someone who likes portable Linux systems? Congratulations, you have a MiniOS referral program now.
translations.mio.tip.support.4: Word of mouth has zero dependencies and works on every architecture.
translations.mio.tip.support.5: Found a bug? GitHub Issues or the Telegram chat are the best places to report it — there we can actually investigate it.
translations.mio.tip.support.6: A bug makes an excellent GitHub Issue. A review cannot answer our debugging questions.
translations.mio.idle.general.1: I'm not watching you. I'm monitoring user engagement.
translations.mio.idle.general.2: No rush. My patience is mostly software.
translations.mio.idle.general.3: I can stand here all day. Battery permitting.
translations.mio.idle.general.4: Just doing important robot things. Very important.
translations.mio.idle.general.5: I've been standing here so long I'm considering becoming a panel applet.
translations.mio.idle.general.6: Idle process consuming approximately one robot.
translations.mio.idle.general.7: Optimus Prime gets a truck. I get a corner of the welcome screen.
translations.mio.idle.general.8: Bender suggested a different support strategy. Legal said no.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.1: Not impatient. Running a finger diagnostics test.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.2: Take your time. I'll just count my fingers again.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.4: This is definitely not passive-aggressive tapping.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.5: Still the same number of fingers. Excellent regression test.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.6: Counting to five is my benchmark suite.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.7: C-3PO would probably explain this gesture for six minutes.
translations.mio.idle.fingers.8: R2-D2 has fewer fingers and somehow gets more done.
translations.mio.idle.nose.1: Don't judge me. I don't even have a nose.
translations.mio.idle.nose.6: This routine is not documented. For good reason.
translations.mio.idle.nose.7: WALL-E would probably use a proper maintenance tool. Show-off.
translations.mio.idle.polish.1: Can't ask for stars looking like this.
translations.mio.idle.polish.3: One moment. Polishing the persuasion module.
translations.mio.idle.polish.5: R2-D2 gets proper detailing. I have this hand.
translations.mio.idle.polish.6: WALL-E would respect this maintenance schedule.
translations.mio.idle.polish.7: Data gets a Starfleet uniform. I get fingerprints.
translations.mio.idle.polish.8: Johnny 5 wants more input. I want fewer smudges.
translations.mio.idle.reboot.5: Marvin says rebooting won't improve my mood. Very encouraging.
translations.mio.idle.reboot.6: HAL 9000 would call this routine. I call it suspicious.
translations.mio.idle.reboot.7: If I start talking about someone named Dave, reboot me again.
translations.mio.idle.reboot.8: R2-D2 gets one worried beep. I need a whole boot sequence.
translations.mio.tip.telegram.1: The Telegram channel also gets technical MiniOS notes that don't fit into release announcements.
translations.mio.tip.telegram.2: Some experimental and special MiniOS ISO images are published only on Telegram — nowhere else.
translations.mio.tip.telegram.3: We also post release progress, known issues, and rebuilt-image notices there.
translations.mio.tip.telegram.4: And the polls aren't decorative — your votes can influence what MiniOS gets next.
